# Chapman Law Group

> > A specialized healthcare defense law firm providing litigation, compliance, and regulatory representation across Florida, Michigan, and California.

Chapman Law Group is a full-service law firm focused on healthcare law with particular expertise in professional licensing, healthcare compliance, fraud defense, and civil litigation. The firm has offices in multiple states and a team of experienced attorneys specializing in regulatory matters, federal investigations, and healthcare-specific legal issues.

## Key Topics

- Healthcare Compliance
- Professional Licensing
- Healthcare Fraud Defense
- Stark Law
- Anti-Kickback Statute
- Federal Criminal Defense
- Medical Malpractice Defense
- HIPAA
- False Claims Act
- Civil Litigation
- White-Collar Defense
- Government Investigations
- Medicare/Medicaid
- Regulatory Compliance
- Business Litigation
